PIXEL-256 / PROGRAMMABLE COMPUTER
CPU, 64 KiB ROM, sparse 2 GiB RAM. Display is on layer 2. F fits the current layer.

KEYBOARD / 126 INDIVIDUAL KEYS
Every key is wired into the CPU matrix. Row bytes are readable at FF80-FF8F. Tab releases capture; OS shortcuts can be reserved.

DEFAULT ROM: Arrows move the cyan selector. Hold A to paint white; hold S to erase.
Program & CPU / Game computer edits ROM bytes. RAM bank 1 is the canvas; cursor overlay never changes painted pixels.
Keyboard index order is documented in keyboard-codes.json. Input states also appear on the individual key nodes.
